content.short: Quadrata is the Web3 protocol for safeguarding on-chain and real-time identity.
content.description: Quadrata delivers user-driven identity safety tools for blockchain users and developers, prioritizing privacy, security, and compliant identity workflows. To address insecure DIDs, Quadrata provides Sybil-resistant DIDs to improve privacy and deter abuse. The platform also supplies SDKs that enable developers to add passport creation and KYC verification to decentralized applications, simplifying onboarding and enabling trusted interactions across networks. Together, these capabilities support verifiable identities without exposing sensitive user data.
